title: Pacific Brands Limited - proposed acquisition of Joyce Corporation Limited's foam business assets.

body_sections.Summary: Pacific Brands Limited proposes to acquire all operating assets of the foam business of Joyce Corporation Limited. Pacific Brands and Joyce are the largest foam manufacturers in Australia.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC concluded that the relevant markets were state based markets for foam.
body_sections.Competition analysis: Please refer to the Public Competition Assessment.
